title: Pressure Washing in Alachua, FL | Soft Wash Siding
description: Pressure washing and soft washing in Alachua, FL: low-pressure cleaning for siding and stucco, high pressure for concrete. Mildew and pollen removed.
heroIntro: Soft washing for painted siding and stucco, and higher pressure only on concrete and pavers, done by the crews who know what paint can take.

questions: Is soft washing safer than pressure washing for my Alachua house?
How do I get green mildew off my siding?
Should I pressure wash before painting?

body: Painters handle washing differently than a washing-only company. We've seen what too much pressure does: it drives water behind siding, etches soft wood, and pulls loose paint off trim. Then the homeowner calls a painter to fix it. Pressure washing in Alachua, FL, the way we do it, uses low-pressure soft washing with a cleaning solution on painted surfaces. Higher pressure is saved for concrete, pavers, and other hard surfaces that can take it.

With humidity staying above 75% for much of the summer, mildew and algae get a head start on the shaded sides of Alachua homes. A soft wash kills the growth at the root instead of just blasting off the green layer on top. Our guide to mold and mildew on siding explains the difference.

sections.h2: Washing on its own or as paint prep
body: Some homeowners just want the house cleaned. A house in Turkey Creek with a green north wall, or a driveway stained from oak drip. Others are washing because a repaint is next. Prep washing is stricter: every bit of chalk and mildew has to come off, and the surfaces need enough dry time before primer. If you're planning an exterior repaint in Alachua, the wash is already part of that scope.

body: Every spring a yellow film settles on screens, windows, and cars across North Central Florida. faqs.q: Will pressure washing damage my paint?
faqs.a: It can if the pressure is too high. That's why we soft wash painted siding, stucco, and trim with low pressure and a cleaning solution, and save high pressure for concrete.

faqs.q: How soon can you paint after washing?
faqs.a: Only once the surface is dry. In humid weather that may take a full day or more, and the painting schedule allows for it.

faqs.q: Can you wash my Main Street storefront or business walkway?
faqs.a: Yes. Commercial washing is scheduled around your hours, including early mornings, nights, or weekends, so customers aren't walking through wet work areas.

faqs.q: How often should an Alachua house be soft washed?
faqs.a: It depends on shade, sprinklers, and how fast growth comes back. Shaded north walls and areas near irrigation usually need attention first. A walkthrough will show whether the whole house needs washing or just a few sides.

faqs.q: Do you protect plants and landscaping?
faqs.a: Yes. Plants are wet down before and after cleaning, runoff is controlled, and landscaping is rinsed before the crew leaves.
